h: David Umahi reportedly questions why Igbos should accept only four years of the presidency
p: The Works Minister is said to have reacted to Peter Obi's single-term pledge, asking why the South-East should settle for four years when others have served eight. His remarks add to the debate over Obi's plan to serve one term if elected in 2027. Supporters of the pledge argue that results matter more than tenure length.
more: Obi has said he would serve a single four-year term if elected on the NDC platform.
Igbo leaders remain divided over the idea.
